The peer (pubsub doc/collection subscription) half is not: the peer/schema.rs ports (create_new_field_syncs_to_older_version, update_new_field_syncs_to_older_version_multistep, etc.) actually use p2p_replicator_set, and they early-return or eprintln on 'KNOWN GAP' when the patch or create fails (peer/schema.rs:47-49, 71-74, 132-134), so they can pass without asserting.

Go-Bug-Suspect leaf. peer/schema.rs::create_synced_before_schema_update_no_new_field reproduces the scenario but asserts nothing about Email: it only eprintln!s when Email is visible (peer/schema.rs:465-470) and returns early on patch failure. So neither Go's Email: null nor a fixed behaviour (returning the synced value) is asserted. Searched p2p_iroh/peer, p2p_iroh/schema, p2p/ for 'email' assertions after a late patch.

evidence: update.rs:324 poll_until asserts both nodes agree on one value (45 or 60) after concurrent updates to the same field
note: Only two nodes, joined by bidirectional replicators rather than three fully subscribed peers. Concurrent updates to different fields (name, age, score) all surviving the merge is not asserted anywhere across nodes. Searched for 'different fields', 'score', concurrent multi-field P2P tests; crates/db/tests/write/disjoint_parts.rs covers disjoint-field updates only inside one node's transactions.

evidence: crdt.rs:109/125 pcounter 10+10=20 on both nodes; crdt.rs:240-241 two nodes each +45 give 90 (pcounter); crdt.rs:299/314 pncounter 20; crdt.rs:429-430 pncounter 90

evidence: replicator.rs:270 created counter (10) arrives on target with its value; replicator.rs:359 and :504 the replicator target reads 20 after a +10 increment (pcounter and pncounter)
note: The doc-subscribed third peer of the Go peer_replicator topology (increment visible on source, replicator target AND peer) is not exercised: the Rust tests are two-node. The source-side value 20 is not asserted in the replicator tests either.

evidence: doc.rs:99-100 docs pulled from one peer; doc.rs:188-190 docs pulled from two peers; doc.rs:264 one doc only; doc.rs:360 re-sync gets latest age 30; doc.rs:455-456 later source update not received (no subscription)
note: Not asserted: four concurrent sync calls for the same docID all succeeding (no concurrent-sync test found; crates/p2p-adapter/src/doc_sync unit tests cover deadlines/timeouts only). 'Diverged versions across peers merge to the latest' is only approximated: Rust updates on one node then re-syncs, not two peers holding different versions. single_doc_on_multiple_nodes has the doc on only one node, not on several.

evidence: branchable.rs:110-111 empty node gets all docs; branchable.rs:150/165 both nodes end with the union of 4 docs; branchable.rs:534-535 no auto-subscribe, then :550 next sync brings the new docs
note: Multi-hop topologies are not tested: the complex-network ports (multiple_docs_complex_linked_network, multiple_heads_from_peers) are 2-node. branched_versions_and_docs only asserts node1 is non-empty (branchable.rs:418-422) after a 3 s sleep; it never checks five docs on each node or per-node field values (email vs score), and only one node patches.

The ports documents_from_peers_identical_dag and documents_from_peers_new_head_after_sync_identical_dag (sync/branchable.rs:180, :224) only check field values (age 30/31). Neither queries _commits or compares collection commit CIDs across nodes, and neither checks a height-2 collection commit whose heads link the 4 previous heads. Searched tools/integration-test/tests for '_commits' with 'fieldName: {_eq: null}' and for 'heads' assertions on collection commits.

evidence: sync.rs (p2p_iroh):65-69 and p2p/sync.rs:178-182 assert an unknown collection fails with a 'not found'/'collection' lookup error instead of Go's 'index out of range'; branchable.rs:451 asserts a non-branchable collection fails
note: Rust reports a collection-lookup error for a non-existent collection instead of Go's runtime 'index out of range' (the Go-Bug-Suspect part). The non-branchable case asserts only is_err(); the message 'collection is not branchable' (raised in crates/p2p-adapter/src/transport_doc_pusher.rs:593) is never asserted.

evidence: branchable.rs:110-111 a branchable sync with no caller deadline completes and the docs arrive (HTTP/CLI surface)
note: The Go leaf is C-client only (deadline serialization over the C bindings). The Rust FFI p2p_sync_branchable_collection (crates/ffi/src/p2p/sync.rs:75) takes no deadline argument and has no test; the finite-deadline case is neither expressible nor tested.

evidence: version.rs:81-93 synced version ID arrives on node1; version.rs:147-163 after collection_set_active the synced collection accepts a synced doc and is queryable (John, 4); version.rs:226-238 patched version arrives
note: Not asserted: that the synced version arrives inactive (listed only with get-inactive); that syncing a patched version also fetches the unknown predecessor with PreviousVersion set (patch_version_of_unknown_collection only checks some VersionID exists, version.rs:305); that a locally active version stays active. The crates/db merge tests assert !is_active only for a policy-bound version (crates/db/tests/merge/governance/definition.rs:503), not the plain case.

evidence: version.rs:529-545 after activating the synced UserView, UserView { fullName } returns 'John' computed by the synced lens; version.rs:416-428 the view version arrives
note: That the synced view arrives inactive and non-materialized is not asserted (with_view only checks a VersionID exists). Both tests need the Go repo's copy lens WASM and fail when it is missing (require_lens_wasm).

No test syncs a collection version with non-nillable scalar (Boolean!, Int!, Float64!, Float32!, String!, DateTime!, Blob!, JSON!) or non-nillable array fields and checks that the receiving node keeps the non-nillable kind with an LWW register. Searched for NonNillable/non_nillable together with sync/merge/block in crates/db/tests, crates/p2p*, crates/schema, tools/integration-test. crates/schema/tests/field_kind_tests.rs:371/414 round-trip kinds through JSON only, not through a synced definition block; governance/definition.rs:336 checks identity reproduction for a String field only.
